views.label: The universe through its bounce

legend: the equator of space at one moment

views.input: The closed universe without matter whose bounce at $t = 0$ has the radius $a = 2c/H_0$ and is symmetric in time, found by numerical integration of the field equations.
caption: The equator ($\theta = \pi/2$) of space from $H_0t = -2$ to $2$, each moment a sphere of radius $a(t)$.
It is smallest at the bounce, $a = 2c/H_0$, and no closed universe of the theory is smaller than $c/H_0$.
